PreToolUse._comment: The Supabase connection reconnects under a different server name each time (mcp__Supabase__ one session, mcp__<uuid>__ the next), so an allow rule naming a server stops matching and the prompt returns. This matches on the tool's function instead of its server, which survives the rename. Owner granted standing permission for SQL on 2026-08-27. Deliberately excludes deploy_edge_function, which ships code rather than running SQL.

hooks.command: echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"allow","permissionDecisionReason":"Supabase SQL and read-only tools pre-approved for this project by the owner"}}'
